entities.summary: Errol Graham Musk is a South African businessman, politician, and the patriarch of the Musk family. He was an Independent member of the Pretoria City Council from 1972 to 1980, and then as a member of Progressive Federal Party from 1980 to 1983. As a businessman, he has worked as a mechanical engineering consultant, developed properties, and invested in various ventures including emerald trading.
